message: Ever had one of those moments when the lights go out and you’re left stumbling around in the dark, wondering where that flashlight is? 🙈 I’ve definitely been there, and it’s a bit like a comedy of errors! I recently found a great resource that covers everything you might need to know about power outages. From staying safe to keeping your food fresh, it’s packed with helpful tips to avoid those ‘uh-oh’ moments. Let’s all be a little more prepared, so we can handle those unexpected blackouts with a wink instead of a panic! What’s your favorite tip for staying calm during a power outage?
